title: Form registry: one data table of every base form (name, family, backend, level, volume)
description:
Single source of truth for form coverage. Elisp data file (e.g. src/edgar-forms.el) mapping each base form -> {family, backend (html|xml|text), level L0/L1/L2, sections-or-fields, Q2-2026 volume, notes}. Seed it from docs/form-coverage.md families and tools/form-survey.sh output: all 245 base forms at L0. Add (edgar-form-info "10-K"), (edgar-forms-by-family ...). Amendments resolve to their base form.
Accept: every form type in the 2026 Q2 index resolves to a registry row (unknown -> error with the form name); registry unit tests; docs/form-coverage.md is generated or checked against it.
Effort (my estimate): half a day; mostly data entry.
close_reason: Implemented registry for 245 forms with unit tests and coverage data; eask run script check passes (92 tests, 1 live test skipped).

title: Legacy and text-only filings: SGML complete-submission .txt, pre-2001 and non-HTML primary docs
description:
Older filings (and some current forms) have a .txt primary document or only the complete submission file (<acc>.txt with <DOCUMENT> SGML wrappers). edgar-text assumes HTML. Add detection, SGML splitting, and plain-text section extraction (Item headings with fixed-width layout). The legacy SC 13G fixtures showed Items run together on one line.
Accept: a 1990s 10-K and the sc-13g-gme fixture produce sections; goldens added.
Effort: 1-2 days; legacy layouts are the long tail of parser pain.
close_reason: Legacy complete-submission primary extraction and real 1998 10-K sections pass offline ERT (commit 7e2d08b).

title: Inline-XBRL facts for a specific filing (in xbrl.el): ix:nonFraction -> tagged values, linked to edgar sections
description:
Cross-repo (lives in xbrl.el, github.com/davidawad/xbrl.el; this bead tracks the edgar.el side). The companyfacts API gives company-level series but not one filing's own contexts, dimensions, footnotes. Parse ix:nonFraction/ix:nonNumeric from the primary doc (libxml) in xbrl.el and expose (edgar-facts filing) / per-section facts here, so 'Item 8 numbers' is a call.
Accept: Apple FY2025 10-K -> Revenue facts with contexts that match companyfacts; offline fixture test.
Effort: 2-3 days (contexts, scales, signs, continuation, dimensional members).

title: Test every L2 form on at least three different filers/layouts (parser robustness)
description:
Honest caveat from the first round: each form was tested on one company's filing (10-K: Apple/Microsoft only). A different filer's heading style (e.g. 'Item 1 -- Business', Roman Part dividers, no Part headings, ITEM in a table) can break the section parser silently. For each L2 form add two more filers of different size/age, with expect + golden coverage; fix what breaks (parser, not tests).
Accept: >=3 filers per L2 form, all golden-green; list of parser fixes made.
Effort: 1-2 days, mostly parser fixes.

title: Raw-XML backend: fetch the structured document behind the XSL rendering and parse it
description:
Primary-document URLs for Forms 3/4/5, 144, 13F, 13G/13D, N-PORT etc. point at an XSL rendering (.../xslF345X06/form4.xml). Dropping the xsl segment gives raw XML (verified for Form 4 and 144 on 2026-10-02). Add (edgar-xml filing) -> parsed tree (libxml-parse-xml-region) plus a plist/alist projector, and handle forms whose primary doc is not XML. Namespaces differ per schema (ownership, edgar/common, 13F informationTable ...); keep that behind one helper.
Accept: Form 4 and Form 144 fixtures parse to trees; tests are offline against recorded XML (store raw XML next to the rendered HTML fixture).
Effort: 1 day, including fixture plumbing for a second document per filing.
close_reason: Implemented raw XML fetch/projector with Form 4 and 144 fixtures; eask run script check passes (92 tests, 1 live test skipped).

title: Multi-document filings: list a filing's documents and read exhibits (EX-99.1, EX-21, EX-10...)
description:
edgar-text only reads the primary document. 8-K press releases (EX-99.1), subsidiaries lists (EX-21), credit agreements (EX-10) and XBRL files live in sibling documents. Use the filing index (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/<cik>/<acc-no-dashes>/index.json) to implement (edgar-documents filing) -> list with type/description/size and (edgar-exhibit filing "EX-99.1"), reusing edgar-text/sections.
Accept: Apple 8-K Item 2.02 -> its EX-99.1 text via edgar-exhibit; offline test with a recorded index.json and exhibit.
Effort: 1 day.
close_reason: Implemented filing document index and EX-99.1 exhibit reading with offline fixture tests; eask run script check passes (92 tests, 1 live test skipped).

title: Transport: throttle to SEC's 10 req/s, retry with backoff, on-disk cache of immutable fetches
description:
Today every call is an unthrottled synchronous url-retrieve. A general utility that sweeps many filings (fixture recording, family sweeps, golden refresh) will hit SEC's 10 requests/second limit and get blocked. Add one fetch layer used by xbrl--get and edgar--fetch: token-bucket throttle, retry on 429/5xx with backoff, honour Retry-After, cache keyed by URL for immutable filing documents (not for submissions/index endpoints), cache dir configurable, gzip Accept-Encoding.
Accept: a burst of 50 stubbed calls never exceeds the rate; cached document is not refetched; tests offline.
Effort: 1 day. Touches xbrl.el's xbrl--get too: coordinate (shared fetch lives in xbrl.el).
close_reason: Implemented throttled cached EDGAR transport with retry/cache/burst tests; eask run script check passes (92 tests, 1 live test skipped).

title: edgar-index: enumerate filings across ALL filers by form/date (full-index, daily-index)
description:
Everything today is by ticker via submissions. Forms like 4, 144, D, 424B2, NPORT-P, ABS-EE are filed by entities with no ticker. Implement (edgar-index-filings YEAR QTR &optional FORM) from https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/full-index/<year>/<QTR>/form.gz and daily-index for recent days, returning filing plists compatible with edgar-filings (incl. :url). tools/form-survey.sh already proves the format.
Accept: list all 10-K filings in 2026 Q2 (~994) with CIK, company, date, URL; test with a trimmed recorded index.
Effort: 1 day.

title: Index-driven fixture recorder: pick a representative filing per form from any filer, plus older vintages
description:
tools/record-fixtures.el picks filings via a hand-maintained ticker list, which cannot reach forms without tickers. Replace with a recorder that, for each registry form, samples the index (recent quarter AND a quarter 3+ years back, since layouts drift), prefers a mid-sized filing under the size cap, and records raw document(s) + metadata into test/fixtures. Deterministic selection (seeded) so reruns are reproducible. Keep fixture size sane (gzip, cap) and decide a limit for total repo size.
Accept: one command records fixtures for every registry form that has any filing in the sampled quarters; reports forms with none.
Effort: 1 day.
